theme_and_archetype.vibe: A focused, motivating, and highly tactile environment. Avoid the standard 'boring SaaS' look. Use Neo-Brutalism (thick 2px black borders, offset solid shadows, flat pastel blocks) to make the app feel like a premium Japanese stationery planner mixed with a cozy lofi cafe.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards to let content breathe.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Bento style: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6
layout_and_spacing.study_room_grid: Grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Video/Presence spans 8 cols. Side panel (Chat/Timer/Tasks) spans 4 cols.

components.button_primary: bg-[#FFE072] text-black border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] active:shadow-none active:translate-y-[4px] active:translate-x-[4px] transition-all
components.button_secondary: bg-[#A7F3D0] text-black border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-bold shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
components.input: bg-white border-2 border-black rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-shadow placeholder:text-gray-400 font-medium

badges.studying: bg-[#A7F3D0] border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-black
badges.break: bg-[#FFE072] border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-black
badges.doubt: bg-[#FBCFE8] border-2 border-black rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold text-black

hero_background.description: Neo-brutalist pastel abstract background for landing page accents or auth screens.

lofi_study_room.description: Aesthetic lofi study room. Use as the main hero image or 'Explore' section header. Give it a 2px black border and shadow.

pomodoro_icon.description: Playful 3D Pomodoro timer illustration. Display alongside the shared timer widget in the study room.

focus_mode_ambient.description: Cozy rain window background. When 'Focus Mode' is ON, crossfade the app background to this image and dim the UI.

student_avatars.description: Use these for participant lists, leaderboards, and user profiles.

specific_page_guidelines.landing_page: High visual impact. Bold H1 with tracking-tighter. Use lofi_study_room image prominently with the neo-brutalist card styling. CTAs should be massive (text-lg or xl, thick borders).
specific_page_guidelines.dashboard: Display Active Rooms, Study Hours, and Streaks in 3 distinct pastel cards (yellow, mint, lavender). Include AI-powered recommendations widget below.
specific_page_guidelines.study_room_view: Bento Grid: 8-col section for Video/Avatars. 4-col section for Chat/Timer/Tasks. Toggle for 'Focus Mode'. Include badges on avatars for (Studying / Break / Doubt).
specific_page_guidelines.focus_mode: When active, enter dark mode styling (#121212), use focus_mode_ambient as a dimmed background cover, hide chat, and expand timer/task list. Add subtle CSS animation to the timer.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Write all React components in .js/.jsx, NOT .tsx. Provide PropTypes if needed, but do not use TypeScript.
CRITICAL: ALWAYS include data-testid attributes on all interactive and key elements.
CRITICAL: Do not use generic SaaS blue colors. Use the exact pastel hex codes provided.
CRITICAL: Override Shadcn UI defaults. Ensure components (inputs, dialogs, cards) use the 2px solid black border and offset shadow defined in components.
Use lucide-react for icons, but set strokeWidth to 2.5 or 3 to match the bold neo-brutalist lines.
Never use placeholder images (via.placeholder.com). Use ONLY the media_urls provided.
Use Framer Motion for micro-interactions, especially the button press effect (scale: 0.98).
